in_sanskrit.name: Julfikar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bright Star
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Julfikar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Julfikar is derived from the Persian words 'jul' meaning 'bright' and 'fikar' meaning 'star'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Hanuman, who is often depicted as a shining star in the night sky.
